2026-11-13.patch_summary: This patch series consists of three cleanups for the vmscan and page_alloc code, aimed at making get_page_from_freelist easier to read. The primary goal is to simplify the code, especially after recent changes related to kswapd zone skipping. No functional changes are intended, only refactoring of existing logic.

reviews.author: Chris Down
reviews.summary:
reviewer noted that the patch does not address the issue of get_page_from_freelist being called from multiple paths, and requested a more comprehensive solution

Reviewer noted that the comment above the function 'If kswapd is already active on a node' would read backwards due to the test being reversed, and suggested rephrasing it to indicate that kswapd is asleep and not reclaiming anything.
reviews.raw_body:
Hi Joshua,

Joshua Hahn writes:

---

Not a big deal, but now that the test is the other way round, this reads
backwards against "If kswapd is already active on a node" in the comment
above the function, because waitqueue_active() being true here means
kswapd is asleep on kswapd_wait. Maybe say something like that
kswapd is asleep, so nothing is reclaiming this? It needn't hold the patch
up though.

I've tested that this works well, so either way please feel free to add:

Reviewed-by: Chris Down <chris@chrisdown.name>
Tested-by: Chris Down <chris@chrisdown.name>

Thanks!

Chris
